title: iPhone Notification
blurb: The iPhone notification sound — arguably the most heard sound on Earth. Every human within earshot will check their phone; that reflex is undefeated and always will be. Use it in edits to signal an incoming text, or play it in a quiet room as a social experiment with immediate and total results. The apex predator of prank sounds.
origin: Apple's default alert tone; the most reflexively recognized sound in modern life.
